finite_recommendation: Stop after candidate source integration. Preserve precision intent. Next separately scoped work must define the A01 operating-temperature/calibration/error allocation and evaluate the retained reference-inverter ratio and control-loading contributions against a reserved remainder for amplifier/reference/load/return effects. Identify one justified necessary correction with a closed contribution budget before further implementation. These networks alone do not establish2mV complete static or1mV load-change accuracy. No automatic component search, knob fitting, product-role downgrade or hardware execution.

matching.temperature_accounting: Use full-temperature ratio envelope directly; do not add matching drift or absoluteTC again. Matching drift only useful for separate anchored delta-temperature calculation. No long-term/moisture/reflow typical shift promoted to lifetime maximum.
